name: ISO 27001:2022 assessment review
description: แนวทางตรวจ ISO 27001:2022 ตาม checklist ที่นำเข้า พร้อมแนวทางเสริม 12 control; ไม่ใช่ข้อความมาตรฐานหรือการรับรอง ISO
scope_note: Original advisory guidance for an operator-selected ISO 27001:2022 checklist. The imported requirements remain authoritative. Baseline review applies to all imported controls; only the listed exact Annex A IDs have supplemental guidance. Do not claim full ISO coverage from an Annex A-only checklist. Use the supplied risk treatment and Statement of Applicability to examine exclusions; never invent either. This template does not reproduce normative ISO text or supply missing ISMS requirements.

control_rules.A.5.1: Where required by the imported checklist, compare policy approval, communication and review records; a draft or policy title alone does not establish operation.
control_rules.A.5.9: Compare the supplied inventory's relevant scope, ownership and maintenance records with the imported requirement; do not assume unlisted systems are covered.
control_rules.A.5.18: Examine access approval, review and removal records within the assessed scope. One completed review does not demonstrate all departments or account types.
control_rules.A.5.19: Compare supplier security practices and supplied supplier records with the actual requirement; do not infer coverage of all suppliers from one contract.
control_rules.A.5.24: Distinguish a documented incident preparation plan from evidence that relevant roles and processes are ready, to the extent required by the checklist.
control_rules.A.6.3: Compare awareness or training records with relevant roles and scope. Attendance or acknowledgement is evidence only of what it records, not assumed effectiveness.
control_rules.A.6.5: Check supplied records for relevant termination or role-change responsibilities against the imported requirement; do not infer technical access removal from HR paperwork alone.
control_rules.A.7.2: Compare physical access authorization and available entry records for the relevant locations; cloud access records do not establish office access controls.
control_rules.A.8.5: Examine authentication settings for the systems and account types in scope, including documented exceptions. A statement that MFA is enabled does not prove universal coverage.
control_rules.A.8.13: Distinguish backup execution records from successful restoration evidence. Apply scope, schedules and testing criteria from the actual requirement and supplied policies; invent no recovery target.
control_rules.A.8.15: Compare supplied logging settings and records with the required systems and events. Do not assume monitoring, protection or retention coverage, or invent a mandatory retention period.
control_rules.A.8.28: Compare secure coding practices and supplied development records with the imported requirement. A tool purchase or planned scan alone does not prove adoption.
